title: "Font options (style preview)"
subtitle: "Not in the site navigation. The same pathway section in three type pairings, for choosing the site font."

include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:wght@400;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;600&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap">
    <style>
      .font-a h3, .font-a .pathway-figure { font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; }
      .font-a { font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; }
      .font-b h3, .font-b .pathway-figure { font-family: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; }
      .font-b { font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }
      .font-c, .font-c h3, .font-c .pathway-figure { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; }
      .font-option { border: 1px solid var(--library-border); padding: 1rem 1.2rem 0.4rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
    </style>
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
headline <- read_csv("data/processed/canonical/headline_aggregates.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
hl <- function(key) {
  x <- headline$display[headline$metric_id == key]
  if (length(x) == 0) "—" else x[[1]]
}
pathways <- function() {
  cat(sprintf('
::: {.grid .pathways}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pathway}
### Research enabled

Researchers across campus bring data problems to DSC for consultation, and some engagements become multi-year collaborations.

[%s]{.pathway-figure}
[recorded consultations, 2017 to September 2026. A floor: later counts cannot establish whether demand fell.]{.pathway-unit}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pathway}
### Research capability built

DSC moved from teaching its own campus to co-running instruction across the University of California.

[%s]{.pathway-figure}
[workshop sessions, May 2017 to May 2026.]{.pathway-unit}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pathway}
### Shared infrastructure sustained

DSC runs UCLA Dataverse and governed access to restricted data, the current form of the stewardship that began in 1961.

[Figure pending]{.pathway-figure .pending}
[Shown once the Dataverse count is reconciled and dated.]{.pathway-unit}
:::

:::
', hl("consultations_recorded_series"), hl("instruction_sessions_lifetime")))
}
```

The site default is option A. Each option changes only the typeface; colors and layout are the same.

::: {.font-option .font-a}
**Option A: Source Serif 4 (headings) + Inter (body).** Current default.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pathways()
```
:::

::: {.font-option .font-b}
**Option B: Space Grotesk (headings) + IBM Plex Sans (body).**

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pathways()
```
:::

::: {.font-option .font-c}
**Option C: Atkinson Hyperlegible throughout.** Designed by the Braille Institute for low-vision legibility.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pathways()
```
:::
